description: Checking for and installing an update, allowed only on Windows. It permits nothing beyond installing a payload signed by the key in tauri.conf.json. This is a separate, platform-gated capability because tauri-plugin-updater is declared only under [target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies] in Cargo.toml: a Linux dev build has no updater to permit, and naming the permission there makes the build script fail with 'Permission updater:default not found' before anything compiles.
